
What order do you want to screen genes 
Step 1: Remove unexpressed genes 
Step 2: Remove genes that are expressed but are contaminant 
Step 3: Remove genes that are not changing 
Step 4: Split genes by max time 
Step 5: Statistical testing of each group
E15 DE  E15-P7 S 
P0-7   E15-P7 S AND P7-P14 S AND P7-P21 H 
P14-56  P7-P14 S AND P7-P21 S AND P7-P21 H  
Minimal FC cutoff for each

select

```{r}
tt <- sce_agg_merged_cc_ann %>%
  dplyr::mutate(max_cat2 = ifelse(max_cat %in% c("unchanged","unexpressed"), NA, max_cat)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group_1_2 = ifelse(expr == FALSE, NA, group_1)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(max_cat2 = ifelse(exclude_cat != "other", NA, max_cat2 )) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(cat_avg_fc = ifelse(cat_avg_fc == "0-1 log2FC", "unchannged", "dynamically expressed" )) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cat_avg_fc_2 = ifelse(exclude_cat != "other", NA, cat_avg_fc )) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(cat_avg_fc_2 = ifelse(max_cat == "unexpressed", NA, cat_avg_fc_2)) %>%
  #dplyr::select(common_id, max_t50_cat, group_1, group_2) %>%
  make_long( expr, group_1_2, cat_avg_fc_2, max_cat2)

ggplot(tt, aes(x = x, 
               next_x = next_x, 
               node = node, 
               next_node = next_node,
               fill = factor(node))) +
  geom_sankey(node.color = 1) +
  theme_sankey(base_size = 16)


```

## K-means clustering with diff1


```{r diff1, fig.height= 6, fig.width= 6}
library(DescTools)
library(pheatmap)
diff1_scott <- t(diff(t(as.matrix(log2_norm_avg_list[[1]])), lag = 1))
colnames(diff1_scott) <- str_c("Scott_", colnames(diff1_scott))
diff1_hatten <- t(diff(t(as.matrix(log2_norm_avg_list[[2]])), lag = 1))
colnames(diff1_hatten) <- str_c("Hatten_", colnames(diff1_hatten))

diff1_all <- cbind(diff1_scott, diff1_hatten)

```

```{r 2fc_kmeans}
toc_t50_fc2 <- subset(toc_t50, ((max_expr_Hatten > expr_cutoff) | (max_expr_Scott > expr_cutoff)) & avg_fc > 2)
dim(toc_t50_fc2)

diff1_all_fc2 <- diff1_all[row.names(diff1_all) %in% row.names(toc_t50_fc2),]

km_diff1 <- kmeans(diff1_all_fc2, centers = 15,  nstart=50,iter.max = 15) 

toc_t50_fc2 <- merge(x =toc_t50, y = as.data.frame(km_diff1$cluster), by.x = 0, by.y = 0)

original_k <-which(colnames(toc_t50_fc2) == "k_15") 
colnames(toc_t50_fc2)[ncol(toc_t50_fc2)] <- "k_15"

row.names(toc_t50_fc2) <- toc_t50_fc2$Row.names
 toc_t50_fc2$Row.names

toc_t50_fc2$k_15 <- as.factor(toc_t50_fc2$k_15)
```

check the optimal number of clusters for log2FC = 1 
code from: 
https://www.r-bloggers.com/finding-optimal-number-of-clusters/
author: https://www.r-bloggers.com/author/sunny-anand/
```{r, eval = FALSE}
set.seed(123)
# Compute and plot wss for k = 2 to k = 15.
k.max <- 20
data <- diff1_all_fc2
wss <- sapply(1:k.max, 
              function(k){kmeans(data, k, nstart=20,iter.max = 15 )$tot.withinss})
wss
plot(1:k.max, wss,
     type="b", pch = 19, frame = FALSE, 
     xlab="Number of clusters K",
     ylab="Total within-clusters sum of squares")



```

```{r}

ggplot(toc_t50_fc2 , aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), y = avg_fc*avg_dir, group = k_15)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=k_15, color=k_15),size = 1) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values=1:nlevels(toc_t50_fc2$k_15)) +   
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_points, labels = names(time_points), name = "Time at 50% max change") + 
  ylab("log2 fold change")
```

```{r, fig.width= 6, fig.height = 6, eval=FALSE}
plot_group_timeline(log2_norm_list_shift, meta_list, km_diff1$cluster , p_time = pseudo_time, ylimits = c(-3,3))
```

log2fc = 1

```{r 1fc_kmeans}
toc_t50_fc1 <- subset(toc_t50, ((max_expr_Hatten > expr_cutoff) | (max_expr_Scott > expr_cutoff)) & avg_fc >= 1 & (toc_t50$hatten_trap_min_pval <= p_val_cutoff | toc_t50$scott_gnp_min_pval <=  p_val_cutoff) )
dim(toc_t50_fc1)
diff1_all <- cbind(diff1_scott, diff1_hatten)
diff1_all_fc1 <- diff1_all[row.names(diff1_all) %in% row.names(toc_t50_fc1),]

km_diff1_fc1 <- kmeans(diff1_all_fc1, centers = 15,  nstart=50,iter.max = 15) 

toc_t50_fc1 <- merge(x = toc_t50_fc1, y = as.data.frame(km_diff1_fc1$cluster), by.x = 0, by.y = 0)
colnames(toc_t50_fc1)[ncol(toc_t50_fc1)] <- "k_15"

toc_t50_fc1$k_15 <- as.factor(toc_t50_fc1$k_15)
```

check the optimal number of clusters for log2FC = 1 
code from: 
https://www.r-bloggers.com/finding-optimal-number-of-clusters/
author: https://www.r-bloggers.com/author/sunny-anand/
```{r, eval = FALSE}
set.seed(123)
# Compute and plot wss for k = 2 to k = 15.
k.max <- 20
data <- diff1_all_fc1
wss <- sapply(1:k.max, 
              function(k){kmeans(data, k, nstart=20,iter.max = 15 )$tot.withinss})
wss
plot(1:k.max, wss,
     type="b", pch = 19, frame = FALSE, 
     xlab="Number of clusters K",
     ylab="Total within-clusters sum of squares")



```

```{r}
dim(toc_t50_fc1)
ggplot(toc_t50_fc1 , aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), y = avg_fc*avg_dir, group = k_15)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape=k_15, color=k_15),size = 1) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values=1:nlevels(toc_t50_fc2$k_15)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_points, labels = names(time_points), name = "Time at 50% max change") + 
  ylab("log2 fold change")
```


Summarize all data in a single table 

Groups: 
1. unexpressed
2. stabily expressed 
3. changing: k means groups 

```{r}
toc_t50$expr <- (toc_t50$max_expr_Hatten > expr_cutoff) | (toc_t50$max_expr_Scott > expr_cutoff)
toc_t50_expr <- toc_t50[toc_t50$expr,]

table(toc_t50$expr)
max_table <- table(toc_t50_expr$avg_max)
max_table
plot(max_table)

table(toc_t50_expr$avg_min, toc_t50_expr$avg_max)

pheatmap(table(toc_t50_expr$avg_min, toc_t50_expr$avg_max), cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, labels_row = names(time_points), labels_col = names(time_points))

toc_t50$max_cat <- cut(toc_t50$avg_max, c(0,2,22,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("E15", "P0_7", "P14_P56"))

table(toc_t50$max_cat, toc_t50$expr)

ggplot(subset(toc_t50, expr & avg_fc > 1.5) , aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), y = avg_fc*avg_dir)) + 
  geom_point(size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~max_cat)
```


```{r, fig.width= 8, fig.height= 8}
toc_t50 <- merge(x = toc_t50, y = as.data.frame(km_diff1_fc1$cluster), by.x = 0, by.y = 0, all.x = TRUE)

colnames(toc_t50)[ncol(toc_t50)] <- "k_15"

toc_t50$k_15 <- as.factor(toc_t50$k_15)

ggplot(subset(toc_t50, expr & avg_fc > 1) , 
       aes(x = Winsorize(avg_t50, maxval = 30), y = Winsorize(avg_fc*avg_dir, minval = -7.5, maxval = 7.5), group = k_15)) + 
  geom_point(aes(shape=k_15, color=k_15), size = 1, alpha = 1) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values=1:nlevels(toc_t50$k_15)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = time_points, labels = names(time_points), name = "Time at 50% max change") + 
  ylab("log2 fold change") +
  facet_wrap(~max_cat)

```

summarize variables by collapsing into groups 
set a specific colour and shape for the groups 

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)

tx_cluster_info <- toc_t50 %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(k_15) %>%
   dplyr::summarise(gene_num = length(k_15),
             avg_fc = which.max(avg_fc),
             scott_fc = median(scott_fc),
             hatten_fc = median(hatten_fc),
             avg_t50 = median(avg_t50),
             scott_t50 = median(scott_t50),
             hatten_t50 = median(hatten_t50),
             avg_dir = mean(avg_dir), 
             avg_max = median(avg_max), 
             avg_min = median(avg_min))


plot(table(toc_t50$avg_max))

tx_cluster_info$max_cat <- cut(tx_cluster_info$avg_max, c(0,2,20,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("E15", "P0_7", "P14_P56"))


hist(toc_t50$avg_t50, breaks = 100)

tx_cluster_info$t50_cat <- cut(tx_cluster_info$avg_t50, c(0,6,18,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("Early", "Mid", "Late"))

tx_cluster_info <- tx_cluster_info[!is.na(tx_cluster_info$k_15),]

tx_cluster_info <- tx_cluster_info[order(tx_cluster_info$avg_max, tx_cluster_info$avg_t50),]
 
tx_cluster_info$color <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Accent"))(15)

tx_cluster_info


toc_t50$max_cat <- cut(toc_t50$avg_max, c(0,2,20,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("E15", "P0_7", "P14_P56"))

toc_t50$t50_cat <- cut(toc_t50$avg_t50, c(0,6,18,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("Early", "Mid", "Late"))

toc_t50$max_t50_cat <- str_c("Max_",toc_t50$max_cat, " ","t50_", toc_t50$t50_cat )


```

Map the newly ordered clusters with the colors back to the t50 table 
```{r}
toc_t50$k_15_ord <- plyr::mapvalues(toc_t50$k_15, tx_cluster_info$k_15, row.names(tx_cluster_info))
toc_t50$k_15_color <- plyr::mapvalues(toc_t50$k_15, tx_cluster_info$k_15, tx_cluster_info$color)
table(toc_t50$k_15_ord)
table(toc_t50$k_15_color)
```

Add expression false as factor for max_cat 
```{r}


toc_t50$max_cat <- as.character(toc_t50$max_cat)
toc_t50$max_cat[toc_t50$avg_fc < 1 | (toc_t50$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff & toc_t50$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged" 
toc_t50$max_t50_cat[toc_t50$avg_fc < 1 | (toc_t50$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff & toc_t50$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged" 
toc_t50$max_cat <- ifelse(toc_t50$expr, as.character(toc_t50$max_cat), "unexpressed")
toc_t50$max_t50_cat <- ifelse(toc_t50$expr, as.character(toc_t50$max_t50_cat), "unexpressed")
toc_t50$max_cat <- as.factor(toc_t50$max_cat)
toc_t50$max_t50_cat <- as.factor(toc_t50$max_t50_cat)

table(toc_t50$max_cat)
table(toc_t50$max_t50_cat)
table(is.na(toc_t50$max_t50_cat))

#hist(toc_t50$max_expr_Hatten[is.na(toc_t50$max_t50_cat)])
head(toc_t50[is.na(toc_t50$max_t50_cat),])

# set the missing genes to unexpressed 
#toc_t50$max_t50_cat[is.na(toc_t50$max_t50_cat)] <-  "unexpressed"

```

Add expression and below fc as caterogories for k means and add colours 
```{r}
toc_t50$k_15_comp <- ifelse(toc_t50$max_cat =="unchanged", "unchanged", as.character(toc_t50$k_15_ord))
table(toc_t50$k_15_comp)
toc_t50$k_15_comp <- ifelse(toc_t50$expr, as.character(toc_t50$k_15_comp), "unexpressed")
table(toc_t50$k_15_comp)
table(is.na(toc_t50$k_15_comp))
toc_t50$k_15_comp <- as.factor(toc_t50$k_15_comp)




# add colors 
toc_t50$k_15_color_comp <- ifelse(toc_t50$max_cat =="unchanged", "gray30", as.character(toc_t50$k_15_color))
table(toc_t50$k_15_color_comp)
toc_t50$k_15_color_comp  <- ifelse(toc_t50$expr, as.character(toc_t50$k_15_color_comp), "gray70")
table(toc_t50$k_15_color_comp)
toc_t50$k_15_color_comp <- as.factor(toc_t50$k_15_color_comp)
new_level <- levels(toc_t50$k_15_comp)[suppressWarnings(order(as.numeric(levels(toc_t50$k_15_comp))))]
toc_t50$k_15_comp <- factor(toc_t50$k_15_comp, levels = new_level)


k2color <- melt(table(toc_t50$k_15_comp, toc_t50$k_15_color_comp))
k2color <- k2color[k2color$value > 0,c(1,2)]
k2color <- k2color[order(k2color[,1]),]
row.names(k2color) <- k2color[,1]
k2color$Var1 <- NULL

k2color_list <- as.list(as.character(k2color[,1]))
names(k2color_list) <- as.character(row.names(k2color))
```

# How many genes increase with differentiation

```{r}
library(parallel)
library(GGally)
table(toc_t50[toc_t50$avg_fc >= 1 | (toc_t50$hatten_trap_min_pval <= p_val_cutoff & toc_t50$scott_gnp_min_pval <=  p_val_cutoff),"max_t50_cat"])


# Calculate the number of cores
no_cores <- detectCores() - 1
 
# Initiate cluster
cl <- makeCluster(no_cores)

group_genes_txchange <- function (df, fc_cutoff, p_val_cutoff, expr_scott_cutoff, expr_hatten_cutoff, 
                                  table_only = FALSE, pval_both = FALSE) {
  new_df <- df
  new_df$max_cat <- cut(df$avg_max, c(0,2,20,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("E15", "P0_7", "P14_P56"))
  new_df$t50_cat <- cut(df$avg_t50, c(0,6,18,64), right=FALSE, labels=c("Early", "Mid", "Late"))
  new_df$max_t50_cat <- str_c("Max_",new_df$max_cat, " ","t50_", new_df$t50_cat )
  new_df$max_cat <- factor(new_df$max_cat)
  new_df$max_t50_cat <- factor(new_df$max_t50_cat)
  # preset the factor levels so that table does miss the levels
  new_df$max_cat <- factor(new_df$max_cat, levels = c(levels(new_df$max_cat), "unchanged", "unexpressed"))
  new_df$max_t50_cat <- factor(new_df$max_t50_cat, levels = c(levels(new_df$max_t50_cat), "unchanged", "unexpressed"))
  
  # modify the groups based upon fc and pval 
  if (pval_both) {
  new_df$max_cat[df$avg_fc < fc_cutoff |  
                   (df$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff | 
                      df$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged" 
  
  new_df$max_t50_cat[df$avg_fc < fc_cutoff |  
                       (df$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff | 
                          df$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged" 
  } else {
  new_df$max_cat[df$avg_fc < fc_cutoff |  
                   (df$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff & 
                      df$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged" 
  
  new_df$max_t50_cat[df$avg_fc < fc_cutoff |  
                       (df$hatten_trap_min_pval > p_val_cutoff & 
                          df$scott_gnp_min_pval >  p_val_cutoff)] <- "unchanged"   
    
  }
  
  new_df$max_cat[df$max_expr_Scott < expr_scott_cutoff & df$max_expr_Hatten < expr_hatten_cutoff] <-  "unexpressed"
  new_df$max_t50_cat[df$max_expr_Scott < expr_scott_cutoff & df$max_expr_Hatten < expr_hatten_cutoff] <- "unexpressed"
  

  if (table_only) {
    cat_tab <- tabulate(new_df$max_t50_cat, nbins = 11)
    cat_tab <- as.vector(cat_tab)
    names(cat_tab) <- levels(new_df$max_t50_cat)
    return(cat_tab)
  } else {
    return(new_df)
  }
}
  
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 1, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE) 
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 1.5, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE) 
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 2, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE) 

group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 1, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE, pval_both = TRUE) 
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 1.5, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE, pval_both = TRUE)  
group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, 2, p_val_cutoff, 100, 100, table_only = TRUE, pval_both = TRUE)  

gene_num_param <- expand.grid(fc = seq(from = 1, to = 10, by = 1), 
                              p_val_cutoff = c(10^(-2:-10)), 
                              expr_scott_cutoff =  seq(from = 0, to = 300, by = 50),  
                              expr_hatten_cutoff = seq(from = 0, to = 300, by = 50))

gene_num <- mcmapply(function(fc_cut, p_val_cut, expr_scott_cut, expr_hatten_cut) group_genes_txchange(toc_t50, fc_cut, p_val_cut, expr_scott_cut, expr_hatten_cut, table_only = TRUE), gene_num_param$fc, gene_num_param$p_val_cutoff, gene_num_param$expr_scott_cutoff, gene_num_param$expr_hatten_cutoff,  mc.cores = 6)

gene_num <- t(gene_num)

max_late_t50_mid <- gene_num_param
gene_num <- as.data.frame(gene_num)
max_late_t50_mid$gene_num <- gene_num$`Max_P14_P56 t50_Late` + gene_num$`Max_P14_P56 t50_Mid`
```

```{r}
    aes(label = expr_hatten_cutoff, colour = as.factor(expr_hatten_cutoff)),
```
